title: Щодо обстановки в сфері кібер на 23-24 лютого 2024 року

entities.name: Сили безпеки і оборони України
entities.gloss: The collective state military and law enforcement apparatus of Ukraine.

entities.name: UAC-0028
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored cyber espionage threat group also known as APT28 or Fancy Bear.

entities.name: UAC-0003
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored advanced persistent threat group also known as Turla.

entities.name: KAZUAR
entities.gloss: A sophisticated backdoor trojan associated with the Turla threat group.

entities.name: UAC-0050
entities.gloss: A financially and politically motivated cyber threat group linked to Russian law enforcement.

entities.name: Росія
entities.gloss: A country spanning Eastern Europe and Northern Asia.

entities.name: DaVinci Group
entities.gloss: A previous operational brand name used by the threat actor UAC-0050.

entities.name: REMCOS RAT
entities.gloss: A commercial remote access trojan frequently used by malicious actors for surveillance.

entities.name: QUASAR RAT
entities.gloss: An open-source remote access tool frequently abused by threat actors for remote administration and espionage.

entities.name: VENOM RAT
entities.gloss: A remote access trojan derived from Quasar RAT used for remote control and data theft.

entities.name: REMOTE UTILITIES
entities.gloss: A legitimate remote desktop software program often abused by threat actors for unauthorized access.

entities.name: LUMMASTEALER
entities.gloss: An information-stealing malware designed to exfiltrate credentials and sensitive data.

entities.name: Telegram
entities.gloss: A cloud-based instant messaging and social media platform.

entities.name: UAC-0010
entities.gloss: A Russian state-sponsored cyber threat group linked to the FSB, also known as Gamaredon or Armageddon.

entities.name: Sandworm
entities.gloss: A Russian military cyber warfare unit within the GRU known for destructive attacks.

relations.head: UAC-0028
relations.evidence: кібершпигунством у відношенні Сил безпеки і оборони України, які були здійсненні угрупуванням UAC-0028

relations.head: UAC-0003
relations.evidence: кібершпигунством у відношенні Сил безпеки і оборони України, які були здійсненні угрупуванням UAC-0028 (APT28) та UAC-0003

relations.head: UAC-0003
relations.evidence: UAC-0003 (Turla), зокрема, із застосуванням модифікованого флагманського шкідливого програмного забезпечення KAZUAR

relations.head: UAC-0050
relations.evidence: угрупування найманців UAC-0050, пов'язаних з правоохоронними структурами Росії

relations.head: UAC-0050
relations.evidence: UAC-0050... оголосивши про припинення "професійної" діяльності під "брендом" DaVinci Group
